-- B-only soil provider. Exact validated C FBX channels; no world writes or publication.
-- The sibling GreenBedGeometryData contains Center/End/Skirt.
local AssetService = game:GetService("AssetService")

local Geometry = {}
local KEYS = { "Center", "End", "Skirt" }
local SIZES = {
	Center = Vector3.new(18.296041720615904, 0.7117668934956944, 18.296041774249794),
	End = Vector3.new(18.296041720615904, 0.7117668934956903, 18.296041720615904),
	Skirt = Vector3.new(21.65385258547726, 1.3001554177724333, 21.318965503815413),
}
local BATCH = 128
local OPTIONS = {
	CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box,
	RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise,
}
local templates = nil
local building = false

local function vector(value)
	assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 3, "Mesh Vector3 triple required")
	for _, number in value do
		assert(
			type(number) == "number" and number == number and math.abs(number) < math.huge,
			"Finite mesh channel required"
		)
	end
	return Vector3.new(value[1], value[2], value[3])
end

local function indices(value, count)
	assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 3, "Triangle corner triple required")
	for _, index in value do
		assert(
			type(index) == "number" and index % 1 == 0 and index >= 1 and index <= count,
			"Mesh corner index outside channel"
		)
	end
end

local function validate(data, key)
	assert(type(data) == "table" and data.key == key, "B green beds neutral geometry key mismatch")
	assert(
		type(data.source_sha256) == "string" and #data.source_sha256 == 64,
		"Source FBX hash required"
	)
	assert(
		type(data.positions) == "table" and #data.positions > 0 and #data.positions <= 500,
		"Bounded vertex channel required"
	)
	assert(
		type(data.triangles) == "table" and #data.triangles > 0 and #data.triangles <= 500,
		"Bounded triangle channel required"
	)
	assert(
		type(data.uvs) == "table" and #data.uvs > 0 and #data.uvs <= 1500,
		"Bounded UV channel required"
	)
	assert(
		type(data.normals) == "table" and #data.normals > 0 and #data.normals <= 1500,
		"Bounded normal channel required"
	)
	assert(
		#data.triangle_uvs == #data.triangles and #data.triangle_normals == #data.triangles,
		"Mesh corner channel count mismatch"
	)
	assert((vector(data.bounds.size) - SIZES[key]).Magnitude < 0.0001, "Neutral mesh size mismatch")
	assert(
		data.texture_uri == "rbxassetid://95855894892409",
		"B green beds palette binding mismatch"
	)
end

local function decorate(part, key, size, texture, sourceHash, sourceName, triangleCount)
	part.Name = sourceName
	part:SetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner", "corn_B_green_beds_v1")
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CastShadow = true
	part.DoubleSided = true
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.Reflectance = 0
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
	part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	part.TextureID = texture
	part.CFrame = CFrame.identity
	part.PivotOffset = CFrame.identity
	part.Size = size
	part:SetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryOwned", true)
	part:SetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey", key)
	part:SetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceSHA256", sourceHash)
	part:SetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceTriangles", triangleCount)
	return part
end

local function neutralTemplate(data, key)
	validate(data, key)
	local editable = nil
	local temporary = nil
	local baked = nil
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		editable = assert(
			AssetService:CreateEditableMesh(),
			"B green beds EditableMesh preparation budget unavailable"
		)
		local vertices, uvs, normals = {}, {}, {}
		local operations = 0
		local function batch()
			operations += 1
			if operations >= BATCH then
				operations = 0
				task.wait()
			end
		end
		for i, value in data.positions do
			vertices[i] = editable:AddVertex(vector(value))
			batch()
		end
		for i, value in data.uvs do
			assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 2, "Mesh UV pair required")
			for _, number in value do
				assert(
					type(number) == "number" and number == number and math.abs(number) < math.huge,
					"Finite mesh UV required"
				)
			end
			uvs[i] = editable:AddUV(Vector2.new(value[1], value[2]))
			batch()
		end
		for i, value in data.normals do
			normals[i] = editable:AddNormal(vector(value))
			batch()
		end
		for i, triangle in data.triangles do
			indices(triangle, #vertices)
			local uv, normal = data.triangle_uvs[i], data.triangle_normals[i]
			indices(uv, #uvs)
			indices(normal, #normals)
			local face = editable:AddTriangle(
				vertices[triangle[1]],
				vertices[triangle[2]],
				vertices[triangle[3]]
			)
			batch()
			editable:SetFaceUVs(face, { uvs[uv[1]], uvs[uv[2]], uvs[uv[3]] })
			batch()
			editable:SetFaceNormals(
				face,
				{ normals[normal[1]], normals[normal[2]], normals[normal[3]] }
			)
			batch()
		end
		-- Object-backed EditableMesh content does not cast native shadows. The
		-- published template is always the opaque session static bake below.
		temporary = assert(
			AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromObject(editable), OPTIONS),
			"B green beds temporary mesh unavailable"
		)
		local status, content = AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync(temporary.MeshContent)
		assert(
			status == Enum.CreateContentResult.Success
				and content.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Opaque,
			"B green beds static geometry bake failed: " .. tostring(status)
		)
		baked = assert(
			AssetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(content, OPTIONS),
			"B green beds static MeshPart unavailable"
		)
		assert(
			baked.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Opaque,
			"B green beds geometry remained editable"
		)
		assert(
			(baked.MeshSize - SIZES[key]).Magnitude < 0.001,
			"B green beds static mesh bounds changed"
		)
		return decorate(
			baked,
			key,
			SIZES[key],
			data.texture_uri,
			data.source_sha256,
			data.name,
			#data.triangles
		)
	end)
	if temporary then
		temporary:Destroy()
	end
	if editable then
		editable:Destroy()
	end
	if not ok then
		if baked then
			baked:Destroy()
		end
		error("B green beds " .. key .. " template failed: " .. tostring(result), 0)
	end
	return result
end

local function validCache(cache)
	for _, key in KEYS do
		local part = cache[key]
		assert(
			part and part:IsA("MeshPart") and part.Parent == nil,
			"B green beds cached template was externally moved or removed"
		)
		assert(
			part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryOwned") == true
				and part:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey") == key,
			"B green beds cached template ownership changed"
		)
	end
end

function Geometry.BuildTemplates()
	while building do
		task.wait()
	end
	if templates then
		validCache(templates)
		return table.freeze(table.clone(templates))
	end
	building = true
	local created = {}
	local ok, problem = pcall(function()
		local dataFolder = assert(
			script.Parent:FindFirstChild("GreenBedGeometryData"),
			"Map B green beds Geometry beside its Data folder"
		)
		for _, key in KEYS do
			local source =
				assert(dataFolder:FindFirstChild(key), "B green beds neutral data missing: " .. key)
			assert(source:IsA("ModuleScript"), "B green beds neutral data must be a ModuleScript")
			created[key] = neutralTemplate(require(source), key)
		end
		validCache(created)
	end)
	building = false
	if not ok then
		for _, part in created do
			part:Destroy()
		end
		error(
			"B green beds templates unavailable; cache remains empty and a later call can retry: "
				.. tostring(problem),
			0
		)
	end
	templates = created
	return table.freeze(table.clone(created))
end

-- CFrame denotes the centered MeshPart. For bottom placement, add Size.Y / 2.
-- Clones remain unparented until the caller publishes a complete test layout.
function Geometry.Clone(key, frame)
	assert(type(key) == "string" and SIZES[key], "Unknown B green beds geometry key")
	assert(typeof(frame) == "CFrame", "B green beds clone CFrame required")
	for _, number in { frame:GetComponents() } do
		assert(
			number == number and math.abs(number) < math.huge,
			"Finite B green beds CFrame required"
		)
	end
	local cache = Geometry.BuildTemplates()
	local clone = assert(cache[key]:Clone(), "B green beds mesh clone unavailable")
	clone.CFrame = frame
	return clone
end

function Geometry.GetSizes()
	return table.clone(SIZES)
end

function Geometry.DestroyCache()
	while building do
		task.wait()
	end
	if templates then
		for _, part in templates do
			part:Destroy()
		end
		templates = nil
	end
end

return table.freeze(Geometry)

-- B-only static soil. The authored session meshes regenerate after engine Save.
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local gameModules = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameShared"):WaitForChild("Game")
local Geometry = require(gameModules:WaitForChild("GreenBedGeometry"))
local Layout = require(gameModules:WaitForChild("GreenBedLayout"))
local OWNER = "corn_B_green_beds_v1"
local PROJECT = "children_of_corn"
local Controller = { Name = "GreenBedController", Order = 43 }

local function target()
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	then
		local field = map:FindFirstChild("FieldZone")
		if field and field:IsA("BasePart") and field.Size == Vector3.new(630, 10, 630) then
			return map
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function owned(folder)
	if folder:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") ~= OWNER then
		return false
	end
	for _, item in folder:GetChildren() do
		if
			not item:IsA("MeshPart")
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner") ~= OWNER
			or #item:GetChildren() ~= 0
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local SOURCES = {
	Center = {
		"SM_Env_Dirt_Rows_Center_01",
		"d74a40009c77e5aad34fff8449e96ef25cf292b419a75355aa3adb50c9914527",
		364,
	},
	End = {
		"SM_Env_Dirt_Rows_End_Top_01",
		"f635796ba1c7ff2f129e77404704444e112ac864a39b64d02636b4932bf9b586",
		469,
	},
	Skirt = {
		"SM_Env_Dirt_Skirt_01",
		"b944eb93ac814ff19320a24409f496a983e5c84faaa5ba7bbb07c555f1bb59b8",
		352,
	},
}
local PART_ATTRIBUTES = {
	BGreenBedsOwner = true,
	BGreenBedGeometryOwned = true,
	BGreenBedGeometryKey = true,
	BGreenBedSourceSHA256 = true,
	BGreenBedSourceTriangles = true,
	BGreenBedTile = true,
}

local function unchangedFrame(actual, expected)
	if not RunService:IsClient() then
		return actual == expected
	end
	local values = { expected:GetComponents() }
	for index, value in { actual:GetComponents() } do
		if
			value ~= value
			or math.abs(value - values[index]) > (if index <= 3 then 0.0001 else 0.00025)
		then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function untouchedEditor(folder)
	if
		not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or not owned(folder)
		or #folder:GetTags() ~= 0
		or folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT
	then
		return false
	end
	for attribute in folder:GetAttributes() do
		if attribute ~= "BGreenBedsOwner" and attribute ~= "corn_project_id" then
			return false
		end
	end
	local children = folder:GetChildren()
	if #children ~= #Layout.SoilTiles then
		return false
	end
	local seen = {}
	for _, item in children do
		local index = item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedTile")
		if
			type(index) ~= "number"
			or index % 1 ~= 0
			or seen[index]
			or not Layout.SoilTiles[index]
		then
			return false
		end
		seen[index] = true
		local tile = Layout.SoilTiles[index]
		local source = SOURCES[tile.Key]
		if
			item.Name ~= source[1] .. "_" .. string.format("%04d", index)
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryOwned") ~= true
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedGeometryKey") ~= tile.Key
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceSHA256") ~= source[2]
			or item:GetAttribute("BGreenBedSourceTriangles") ~= source[3]
			or not unchangedFrame(item.CFrame, tile.Frame)
			or item.Size ~= tile.Size
			or item.PivotOffset ~= CFrame.identity
			or item.TextureID ~= "rbxassetid://95855894892409"
			or item.Color ~= Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			or item.Material ~= Enum.Material.Plastic
			or item.Transparency ~= 0
			or item.Reflectance ~= 0
			or not item.Anchored
			or item.CanCollide
			or item.CanTouch
			or item.CanQuery
			or not item.CastShadow
			or not item.DoubleSided
			or #item:GetTags() ~= 0
		then
			return false
		end
		for attribute in item:GetAttributes() do
			if not PART_ATTRIBUTES[attribute] then
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Controller:_restore()
	for part, value in self._hidden do
		if part.Parent then
			part.LocalTransparencyModifier = value
		end
	end
	table.clear(self._hidden)
end

function Controller:_clear()
	self._epoch += 1
	self:_restore()
	if self._folder and self._folder.Parent and owned(self._folder) then
		self._folder:Destroy()
	end
	self._folder, self._map = nil, nil
	self._index = 1
	self._ready = false
end

function Controller:_build(map)
	self:_clear()
	self._map = map
	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "CornClientGreenBeds"
	folder:SetAttribute("BGreenBedsOwner", OWNER)
	folder:SetAttribute("corn_project_id", PROJECT)
	folder:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
	folder:SetAttribute("LoadedParts", 0)
	folder.Parent = map
	self._folder = folder
	self._building = true
	local epoch = self._epoch
	task.spawn(function()
		local ok, problem = pcall(Geometry.BuildTemplates)
		if epoch ~= self._epoch then
			return
		end
		self._building = false
		if not ok then
			self:_clear()
			self._failedMap = map
			warn("[GreenBedController] Saved preview retained: " .. tostring(problem))
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:_step(delta)
	self._poll += delta
	if self._poll >= 1 then
		self._poll = 0
		local map = target()
		if map ~= self._map then
			if map and map ~= self._failedMap then
				self:_build(map)
			else
				self:_clear()
			end
		end
	end
	if not self._map or not self._folder or self._building or self._ready then
		return
	end
	local start, count = os.clock(), 0
	while self._index <= #Layout.SoilTiles and count < 8 and os.clock() - start < 0.002 do
		local tile = Layout.SoilTiles[self._index]
		local item = Geometry.Clone(tile.Key, tile.Frame)
		item.Size = tile.Size
		item:SetAttribute("BGreenBedTile", self._index)
		item.Parent = self._folder
		self._index += 1
		count += 1
	end
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LoadedParts", self._index - 1)
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameClones", count)
	self._folder:SetAttribute("LastFrameSeconds", os.clock() - start)
	if self._index > #Layout.SoilTiles then
		local saved = self._map:FindFirstChild("GreenBedEditor")
		if saved then
			assert(untouchedEditor(saved), "Manual editor beds preserved")
			for _, item in saved:GetChildren() do
				self._hidden[item] = item.LocalTransparencyModifier
				item.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			end
		end
		self._ready = true
		self._folder:SetAttribute("Ready", true)
	end
end

function Controller:Init(context)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio() and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
	self._epoch, self._poll, self._index = 0, math.huge, 1
	self._hidden = {}
	self._ready, self._building = false, false
end

function Controller:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		local ok, problem = pcall(self._step, self, delta)
		if not ok then
			local failed = self._map
			self:_clear()
			self._failedMap = failed
			warn(
				"[GreenBedController] Soil build failed; old preview retained: "
					.. tostring(problem)
			)
		end
	end)
end

function Controller:Destroy()
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clear()
end

return Controller
